verdict.rationale: Teams documents both Incoming and Outgoing Webhooks, letting external services subscribe to channel message events and post updates into channels (ms-teams-docs-12, ms-teams-docs-30, ms-teams-docs-34), which satisfies a basic 'subscribe to events via webhook' pattern for AI-native integrations. However, evidence only covers channel-message-level webhooks/connectors, not a broader Graph-based event subscription/change-notification system for other Teams events (meetings, presence, membership changes), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: documented Graph webhook subscriptions for non-message Teams events, and independent verification of webhook delivery/robustness.
